title.zh: a16z旗舰区块链基金移除「Crypto」名称并更名为a16z Frontier
title.en: a16z removes 'Crypto' from flagship blockchain fund, renamed a16z Frontier

current_state.zh: Andreessen Horowitz将其加密基金更名为“a16z Frontier”，并将授权范围扩展至AI、自主机器和生物学，同时表示将继续投资加密货币；市场回顾指出BTC报81.8万美元、BTC ETF净流出6.35亿美元。
current_state.en: Andreessen Horowitz renamed its crypto fund 'a16z Frontier' and expanded its mandate to AI, autonomous machines and biology while maintaining that it will continue investing in crypto, alongside a market recap noting BTC at $81.8k and $635M in BTC ETF net outflows.

updates.title_zh: 【a16z Frontier 确认将继续布局加密领域，并拓展至更广泛的前沿科技初创企业】
updates.title_en: 【a16z Frontier 确认将继续布局加密领域，并拓展至更广泛的前沿科技初创企业】
updates.what_changed_zh: a16z 正式公告将 a16z crypto 更名为 a16z Frontier，并把新基金投资范围从加密货币初创公司扩展至更广泛的前沿科技初创公司，同时继续投资加密货币及相关企业并倡导合理监管；新基金由 Chris Dixon、Marc Andreessen、Ben Horowitz、Eddy Lazzarin 和 Guy Wuollet 共同领导。
updates.what_changed_en: a16z officially announced that a16z crypto is renamed a16z Frontier and that the new fund's scope is expanded from crypto startups to broader frontier technology startups while continuing to invest in crypto and related companies and advocate for sensible crypto regulation; the fund is led by Chris Dixon, Marc Andreessen, Ben Horowitz, Eddy Lazzarin, and Guy Wuollet.
updates.current_state_zh: a16z crypto 已正式更名为 a16z Frontier，新基金将在继续布局加密货币及相关企业的同时，拓展至更广泛的前沿科技初创企业。
updates.current_state_en: a16z crypto has officially been renamed a16z Frontier, and its new fund will continue investing in crypto and related companies while expanding into broader frontier technology startups.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: a16z crypto has renamed itself a16z Frontier and expanded its new fund's investment scope from crypto startups to broader frontier technology while continuing to invest in and advocate for crypto.
updates.detailed_summary_en: a16z crypto has renamed itself a16z Frontier and expanded its new fund's investment scope from crypto startups to broader frontier technology while continuing to invest in and advocate for crypto.
updates.background_zh: a16z 已披露的加密投资包括 Coinbase、Solana 区块链和 Uniswap。今年 1 月，该公司表示其各只基金合计募资超过 150 亿美元，联合创始人 Ben Horowitz 在公司文章中称，使命“始于赢得未来的关键架构——AI 与加密”。Dixon 表示，自 2013 年加入 a16z 以来，长周期投资一直是他的重点，这一主题带来了对 Oculus 以及 Skydio、Zipline 等无人机初创公司的投资。
updates.background_en: a16z's disclosed crypto bets include Coinbase, the Solana blockchain and Uniswap. In January the firm said it had raised more than $15 billion across its funds, and co-founder Ben Horowitz wrote that the mission "starts with winning the key architectures of the future—AI and crypto." Dixon has said long-horizon investing has been his focus since joining a16z in 2013, a theme that led to investments in Oculus and drone startups such as Skydio and Zipline.
updates.market_impact_zh: 更名本身不会直接改变资金或流动性，其传导路径主要落在加密风险投资的情绪与叙事层面：a16z 保留的加密持仓（已披露的包括 Coinbase、Solana 和 Uniswap）及其监管倡导，是直接的风险敞口所在。若资金向 AI 与前沿科技倾斜，更可能先体现在后续融资轮次中，而非现货市场。
updates.market_impact_en: The rename does not itself move capital or liquidity; its transmission path runs through crypto venture-funding sentiment and narrative, with a16z's retained crypto holdings (Coinbase, Solana and Uniswap among disclosed bets) and its regulatory advocacy remaining the direct points of exposure. Any tilt of capital toward AI and frontier tech would surface first in future funding rounds rather than in spot markets.

updates.title_en: Morning Minute: a16z Drops 'Crypto' From Its Fund
updates.what_changed_zh: Andreessen Horowitz将其加密基金更名为“a16z Frontier”，并将授权范围扩展至AI、自主机器和生物学，同时表示将继续投资加密货币；市场回顾指出BTC报81.8万美元、BTC ETF净流出6.35亿美元。
updates.what_changed_en: Andreessen Horowitz renamed its crypto fund 'a16z Frontier' and expanded its mandate to AI, autonomous machines and biology while maintaining that it will continue investing in crypto, alongside a market recap noting BTC at $81.8k and $635M in BTC ETF net outflows.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Andreessen Horowitz renamed its crypto fund 'a16z Frontier' and expanded its mandate to AI, autonomous machines and biology while maintaining that it will continue investing in crypto, alongside a market recap noting BTC at $81.8k and $635M in BTC ETF net outflows.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Andreessen Horowitz renamed its crypto fund 'a16z Frontier' and expanded its mandate to AI, autonomous machines and biology while maintaining that it will continue investing in crypto, alongside a market recap noting BTC at $81.8k and $635M in BTC ETF net outflows.
updates.background_zh: a16z crypto 自 2013 年起就在各个阶段投资加密与区块链初创公司；今年 5 月的那期基金是其第五只专项加密基金，使其加密领域累计募资额达到 98 亿美元。此次更名之际，比特币年内下跌，资本正与占据主导地位的 AI 交易争夺注意力。同一份简报还提到 BTC 报 81,800 美元、ETH 报 2,400 美元，以及比特币 ETF 净流出 6.35 亿美元。
updates.background_en: a16z crypto has invested in crypto and blockchain startups across all stages since 2013, and the May fund — its fifth dedicated crypto vehicle — brought total crypto capital raised to $9.8 billion. The rebrand lands with bitcoin down on the year and capital competing against a dominant AI trade. The same newsletter cited BTC at $81.8k, ETH at $2,400 and $635 million in net outflows from bitcoin ETFs.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次更名是加密风险资本配置方式的一个信号：当一只旗舰加密基金正式把职权范围扩大到人工智能和生物学时，加密初创公司可能在争夺同样的合伙人关注与资金时面临更激烈的竞争。简报同时提到比特币 ETF 净流出 6.35 亿美元，这反映的是另一条渠道，即现货 ETF 需求，它一直在拖累市场情绪；不过这两件事是被并列报道的，而非因果关系。
updates.market_impact_en: The rebrand is a signal about how crypto venture capital allocates capital: if a flagship crypto fund formally widens its remit to AI and biology, crypto startups may face tougher competition for the same partner attention and dollars. The newsletter's simultaneous note of $635 million in bitcoin ETF net outflows reflects a separate channel — spot ETF demand — that has been weighing on sentiment, though the two items are reported side by side rather than as cause and effect.
